title: The Archipelago Island Survey
statement:
A nautical map represents an ocean region as an R x C binary grid. '1' represents land and '0' represents water. An island is formed by connecting adjacent lands horizontally or vertically (diagonal lands do not connect).

Given the grid, count and print the total number of distinct islands.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers R and C.
Next R lines: Strings of length C consisting of 0s and 1s.

sampleCases.explanation: All connected 1s form one large island.
